content_text: IMO, “shaky cam” is just a tool for enhancing the viewer’s emotions and provide the right “feeling” of the moment. Personally, I don’t have a problem with it as long as it’s someon’s “point of view” or just logically valid and not overused. Same as shallow depth of field: not for a “style” or “beauty”, but another tool for telling a story.
